test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

“We had opened the lock.” they told me.

options.text: They said that we had opened the lock.
They said to me that they have opened the lock.
They told me that they had opened the lock.
They says that we had opened the lock.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) 'They told me that they had opened the lock.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**. As per the given directions, we have to change it into **Indirect Speech.**
